policy: verbatim copies of the files the T7 port needs (no edits): the Angry Birds prompt strategy is imported by the adapter by file location (it has no imports); the runner, the Qwen provider, the dispatch and img_utils are reference copies whose functions the G-port reference executes from source. The PHYRE G-fid runs the official deepphy.runner.01_phyre_runner from the pinned clone /mnt/array/sukaih/novphy-baselines-src/DeepPHY@0562104/ (not vendored).

conf/env_config_05_angrybirds.json.role: reference: Angry Birds level data (bird_type lists, slingshot positions)

deepphy/planner/prompt_strategy_05_angry.role: imported by the adapter by file location (system_prompt_angry_birds, get_user_prompt_angrybirds)

deepphy/provider/llm/qwen.py.role: reference: initialize_qwen_vlm / get_qwen_model_response (the local Qwen2.5-VL inference path) executed by the G-port reference

deepphy/runner/05_angrybirds_runner.py.role: reference: get_llm_action / parse_and_execute_action / the response-parsing lines of play_level_with_llm are executed from this source by the G-port reference (AST-extracted, GUI calls stubbed); not imported at run time

deepphy/utils/img_utils.py.role: reference: crop_image_by_cm (the iPhone-mirroring title-bar crop; not applied to NovPhy frames, Decision P-adapter)
